Source unavailable: preserve source-specific coverage and any valid dated snapshot; “View coverage” opens the existing coverage receipt. A source retry is offered only when the producer owner supplies that read callback.
Access provider unavailable: the current entitlement owner may retry the existing access check. Do not label the user denied, expired or in need of a different plan.
